about: Elizabethtown-Kitley is a township in Leeds and Grenville, Ontario, wrapping around the separate City of Brockville—not Brockville itself. Hamlets such as Lyn, Toledo, Addison, and New Dublin sit among farmland north of the St. Lawrence. About 10,000 people live in Elizabethtown-Kitley Township.
